config.protocol: Predeclared before fitting; all choices and checkpoints frozen by validation before the final held-out evaluation.

source.title: The Varieties of Religious Experience: A Study in Human Nature
source.author: William James
source.license: Project Gutenberg; public domain in the USA. Full source notice retained in the raw text.

corpus.split: Source-order whole paragraphs; floor(0.8*N), floor(0.9*N). Split each assigned paragraph into sentence sequences afterward; no source paragraph spans subsets.
corpus.tokenization: NFC lowercase words and numbers; retain internal apostrophes/hyphens, alphanumeric codes and decimal numbers. Protect common abbreviations, initials/acronyms and decimals before heuristic .!? sentence splitting. Append EOS per sentence.
corpus.cleaning: Keep the twenty main lectures from the exact uppercase Lecture I heading to before POSTSCRIPT. Exclude preface, contents, postscript, index, endnotes and Gutenberg wrappers. Remove lecture headings, decorative separators and attached numeric footnote references. Keep quotations and numbered lists in the lectures. Join wrapped lines inside whole source paragraphs; normalize typographic hyphens.

metric_definitions.nll: Mean negative natural log conditional probability of all tokens, including UNK and EOS.
metric_definitions.perplexity: exp(nll), evaluated on the same fixed train-only vocabulary for every model.
metric_definitions.top1_top3_top5: Fraction of lexical targets among the top k lexical suggestions; UNK targets count as misses; EOS targets excluded; no sampled positions.
metric_definitions.teacher_forcing: Every prediction sees only preceding true words within its sentence; state resets for every sentence.
metric_definitions.selection: Validation only; HMM/RNN absolute best epoch restored on validation NLL. Early-stopping patience uses minimum NLL improvement 0.0001. Test run only after all choices frozen.
metric_definitions.context: Same complete preceding sentence available to all models; no cross-sentence state or fixed context-window ablation. N-grams inherently use only order-1 preceding tokens.
metric_definitions.parameter_count: Number of stored model probability scalars for count/HMM models, or learned neural weight scalars for RNN; context-ID storage excluded. HMM constrained free-parameter count is also given.
metric_definitions.training_seconds: Measured wall time of the retained fit including per-epoch train/validation scoring; baseline search cost recorded separately. History elapsed_seconds is cumulative within that fit.
metric_definitions.test_comparisons: All prespecified HMM/RNN variants and validation-selected baseline per order are shown descriptively; test scores do not select a model.

parameters.architecture: Unidirectional Elman tanh RNN, embedding and linear-softmax output; full-sentence BPTT; gradient clipping norm 5.
